edit.find: 2. ArrivalAndTravelSetup, 44 ticks: places itself (the leader's dot) at the start position, centres the camera, then each tick adds the TickGravity delta (always negative: -$20 rising to about -2) to $B8.
edit.with: 2. ArrivalAndTravelSetup, 44 passes of a loop that yields twice per pass (SetEntryHereAndYield, then the non-final LoopEnd): 2 ticks per pass, about 88 ticks. It places itself (the leader's dot) at the start position, centres the camera, then each pass adds the TickGravity delta (always negative: -$20 rising to about -2) to $B8.

partNotes.ArrivalAndTravelSetup: Child actor (flags $3800, script-driven). Phases: a zoom-out of 44 passes at 2 ticks per pass (about 88 ticks; $B8 falls), for a menu trip a 16-tick wait + WorldMapSplitEffect + wait for the player's route, the 93-tick tilt phase with the start name ($B6 grows), then the companion dots. It finally becomes the leader's dot through the shared loop in CompanionDotMovement and dies when the route ends.
partNotes.RouteDeltaTables: Normal step: byte 0 (the X chain index, already read) and bytes 1 and 2 (the Y and rotation chain indices) select the delta chains in move_chain_table ($18, $1A, $1C), and byte 3, the tick count n, is stored in $24. SetEntryHere only saves the re-entry point (it does not yield); the actor adds the next delta of each active axis and yields at the RTL in RouteCountTick, so the step applies its deltas n + 1 times, once per tick.

238454.text: v0 = $20, shift 5: delta of pass t = ((t * (t >> 1)) >> 5) - $20, negative for all 44 passes (sum about -970)

238459.text: 44 passes of zoom-out; each pass yields twice (SetEntryHereAndYield, then the non-final LoopEnd): 2 ticks per pass, about 88 ticks

238475.text: Yield 1 of 2 in each pass: the actor resumes after this COP on the next tick

238477.text: Yield 2 of 2: a non-final LoopEnd sets $00 to the loop head and yields; the 44th pass falls through into the next line in the same tick

238913.text: Read byte 0 of the step from [$2C]: $FF = end of route, $FE = subroutine call, otherwise the X chain index

238936.text: Byte 0 (X chain index) x 2 = word index into move_chain_table for the X delta source

238957.text: Read byte 2 (rotation chain index; the chain is added to $BC below)

238966.text: Look up rotation delta source pointer from move_chain_table

238971.text: Read byte 3 (tick count n) -> $24: the step applies its deltas n + 1 times, one per tick

238980.text: Re-entry point for each tick of this step (SetEntryHere does not yield; the yield is the RTL in RouteCountTick)

239038.text: Rotation axis: check for null pointer

239042.text: Read rotation delta from indirect pointer

239059.text: Decrement the tick counter; negative = step complete -> next step

239063.text: Counter still non-negative: yield (RTL) until the next tick

edit.find: Entries $00 and $1C-$26 are never staged. $00 only returns (the controller dies before SwitchCase when the choice id is 0); $1C-$25 print an empty [TPL:11] and return; $26 prints Nothing!!.
edit.with: Staged ids are $01-$1B: each is written by one StageWorldMapChoice site in overworld_exit, and the only other writer of $0D58 is StageWorldMapMove, which clears it. Entry $00 only returns (the controller dies before SwitchCase when the choice id is 0). Ids $1C-$1F are never staged, but the controller keeps the low 5 bits (AND #$001F), so staging one would run its entry. Entries $20-$26 cannot be reached by any id, because the table index is at most $1F. $1C-$25 print an empty [TPL:11] and return; $26 prints Nothing!!.

partNotes.world_map_options: 39 pointers indexed by the choice id & $1F, so only entries $00-$1F can be selected: $01-$1B are the menus staged by overworld_exit, $00 and $1C-$1F are never run ($00 never reaches SwitchCase, no site stages $1C-$1F), and $20-$26 cannot be reached by any id. edit.find: The game cannot be started on a PAL console.
edit.with: In the unpatched ROM the game cannot be started on a PAL console. The shipped baserom patch baserom/fixes-tweaks/Utils.patch.asm rewrites BootLogoPalLockout! as one BRA BootLogoNtsc, so the JMP in BootLogoInit lands on the NTSC logo path and a PAL console skips the lockout screen (static reading of the patch).
